label: Restricted first-order plus finite-reachability specification
definition: PathFormula has a first-order formula leaf over ordinaryLanguage, negation, conjunction and finite reflexive reachability along an admitted ordinary binary relation between free variable endpoints. No arbitrary semantic predicate leaf, object constant, function-valued target atom, predicate quantifier or syntax choice indexed by interpretation exists. Endpoints use the same permitted-parameter subtype as FO. Path is a finite inductively generated edge sequence including zero edges; it is graph connectivity, not causation or composition. Nat successor reaches two from zero without a direct edge; an edgeless Bool graph cannot connect false to true. This is a restricted richer syntax, not all richer languages and not a proof of strict FO expressive separation.
